items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Lions live in Africa. They are large cats that hunt in groups called prides.'

Text B: 'Lions are powerful animals. A male lion has a thick mane of fur around its head.'

Name one thing that both texts say about lions.
items.answer: Both texts say that lions are large, powerful animals (or that they are a type of cat). Both texts are about lions.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The moon orbits Earth. It takes about 28 days to travel around Earth one time.'

Text B: 'The moon has no air or water. No plants or animals can survive there.'

What does Text A tell you about the moon that Text B does not?
items.answer: Text A tells you that the moon orbits Earth and how long it takes (about 28 days). Text B does not mention this.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Dogs were first tamed from wolves thousands of years ago. Early humans kept dogs to help them hunt.'

Text B: 'Dogs help people in many ways today. Some dogs guide people who are blind. Others sniff out illegal items at airports.'

What does Text B tell you about dogs that Text A does not?
items.answer: Text B tells you about the jobs dogs do today, like guiding blind people and sniffing at airports. Text A does not mention modern dog jobs.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Water can be liquid, solid, or gas. When water freezes it becomes ice. When water heats up it becomes steam.'

Text B: 'Water covers most of Earth's surface. Oceans, lakes, rivers, and glaciers all contain water.'

Name one thing both texts have in common.
items.answer: Both texts are about water. (Accept other reasonable similarities such as: both mention that water can take different forms or exist in different places on Earth.)

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Frogs lay their eggs in water. The eggs hatch into tadpoles, which slowly grow legs and become frogs.'

Text B: 'Frogs eat insects like flies and mosquitoes. They catch their food with a long, sticky tongue.'

Which text tells you about the life cycle of a frog? Which tells you about how frogs eat?
items.answer: Text A tells you about the life cycle of a frog (eggs, tadpoles, adult frogs). Text B tells you about how frogs eat (catching insects with a sticky tongue).

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Sharks have been on Earth for millions of years. They are older than dinosaurs.'

Text B: 'Sharks are important to ocean ecosystems. They hunt sick and weak animals, keeping the ocean healthy.'

What does Text A tell you that Text B does not? What does Text B tell you that Text A does not?
items.answer: Text A tells you that sharks have existed for millions of years and are older than dinosaurs. Text B tells you that sharks help keep the ocean healthy by hunting sick and weak animals.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Rain falls from clouds. Water collects on the ground and flows into rivers, lakes, and oceans.'

Text B: 'Rainwater soaks into the ground. Plants and trees absorb this water through their roots.'

Both texts are about what happens to rain. Name one similarity.
items.answer: Both texts describe what happens to rainwater after it falls from clouds. Both agree that rain eventually reaches the ground.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth. It is located in the Himalayan Mountains between Nepal and Tibet.'

Text B: 'Climbing Mount Everest is very difficult. The air near the top is thin and very cold. Many climbers need oxygen tanks to breathe.'

Which text gives information about where Mount Everest is? Which gives information about climbing it?
items.answer: Text A gives information about where Mount Everest is (in the Himalayas between Nepal and Tibet). Text B gives information about the challenges of climbing it (thin air, cold temperatures, oxygen tanks).

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Bats come out at night to find food. They eat thousands of insects in a single night.'

Text B: 'Bats sleep during the day hanging upside down. They sleep in large groups in caves or trees.'

What is one thing that both texts tell you about bats?
items.answer: Both texts tell you that bats are active at night and sleep during the day. (Accept other reasonable common points, such as both describe bat behavior.)

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'In ancient Egypt, people built huge stone pyramids. The pyramids were tombs for pharaohs, who were the rulers of Egypt.'

Text B: 'The ancient Egyptians also built the Great Sphinx. The Sphinx has the body of a lion and the head of a human. It stands near the pyramids.'

What do both texts have in common?
items.answer: Both texts are about ancient Egyptian monuments or structures. Both describe large stone structures built by ancient Egyptians.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'George Washington was the first president of the United States. He led the American army during the Revolutionary War.'

Text B: 'George Washington was born in Virginia in 1732. He grew up on a farm and became a military leader.'

Name one fact that ONLY Text A tells you.
items.answer: Only Text A tells you that Washington was the first president of the United States or that he led the American army during the Revolutionary War.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth. It covers more than 60 million square miles.'

Text B: 'The Pacific Ocean is home to thousands of sea creatures including dolphins, sea turtles, and colorful fish.'

Name one fact that ONLY Text B tells you.
items.answer: Only Text B tells you that the Pacific Ocean is home to sea creatures like dolphins, sea turtles, and colorful fish.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Volcanoes can erupt without warning. Hot lava flows down the sides and can destroy everything in its path.'

Text B: 'Volcanoes also release ash and gas into the air. Ash can block sunlight and affect the weather for months.'

Both texts are about volcanic eruptions. Name one thing they each say about what eruptions can do.
items.answer: Text A says lava can destroy everything in its path. Text B says ash can block sunlight and affect weather for months.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Giraffes have very long necks. This helps them reach leaves at the tops of tall trees.'

Text B: 'Giraffes are the tallest animals on Earth. A full-grown giraffe can be up to 18 feet tall.'

Name one similarity and one difference between what the two texts say about giraffes.
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts say giraffes are very tall. Difference: Text A explains how the giraffe uses its height (to reach leaves). Text B gives a specific measurement of how tall giraffes can be (18 feet).

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The cheetah is the fastest land animal. It can run up to 70 miles per hour in short bursts.'

Text B: 'Cheetahs are endangered. Habitat loss and hunting have greatly reduced their population.'

If you wanted to learn why cheetahs are in danger, which text would you read? Why?
items.answer: You would read Text B because it explains that cheetahs are endangered and gives two reasons: habitat loss and hunting. Text A only gives information about how fast cheetahs run.
